title: TrackFlow Telemetry Event Schemas
description: Event catalog for TrackFlow warehouse & last-mile delivery telemetry. Each event must conform to exactly one of the schemas defined in the oneOf array. The common envelope is shared by all events; the 'event_type' and 'properties' fields discriminate between event types. Schema version 1.0. Incompatible future payload changes require a schemaVersion update.

uuidString.description: UUID v4 format, lowercase hexadecimal with hyphens.

nullableUuid.description: UUID v4 or null. Used for optional identifiers such as sessionId and requestId.

oneOf.description: User UUID (stable, non-enumerable TinyDB field). Never email, doc_id, or hashed_password.

nullableUserId.description: User UUID or null. Null when the actor identity does not exist or is not resolved.

iso8601Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with no offset component, e.g. '2026-10-05T14:30:00.000Z'.

commonEnvelopeProperties.description: Common envelope required for every telemetry event. No additional top-level fields are permitted. sessionId is null for backend-only events. requestId is null for frontend-only events. userId is null when actor identity does not exist.

incidentOrigin.description: Source origin of the incident report.

incidentStatus.description: Valid lifecycle states for an incident.

httpMethod.description: HTTP method for API request events.

failureReason.description: Normalised reason for login failure. The producer can distinguish email-not-found from wrong-password (separate code branches), and inactive-account (is_active check). All three return the same public HTTP 401 message for anti-enumeration. Email format validation is handled by Pydantic before the handler executes, producing api_validation_error instead.

title_length.description: Length of the incident title in characters (derived — not the raw text).

incidentCreatedProperties.description: Properties for incident_created. Raw title and description are explicitly forbidden.

incidentStatusTransitionProperties.description: Properties for incident_status_transition. Incident description and title are explicitly forbidden.

client_name.description: Client brand name associated with the SKU.

inboundRegisteredProperties.description: Properties for inbound_registered. Reference strings (PO numbers) and user_uuid are explicitly forbidden.

has_tracking.description: Whether the outbound movement has a tracking reference (boolean only — never raw tracking number).

outboundRegisteredProperties.description: Properties for outbound_registered. Raw tracking_number and user_uuid are explicitly forbidden.

outboundInsufficientStockProperties.description: Properties for outbound_insufficient_stock. Raw exception text and stack trace are explicitly forbidden.

warehouseMismatchRejectedProperties.description: Properties for warehouse_mismatch_rejected. Raw exception text, stack trace, and user identification beyond the envelope are explicitly forbidden.

skuDuplicateRejectedProperties.description: Properties for sku_duplicate_rejected. Raw exception text and stack trace are explicitly forbidden.

loginSucceededProperties.description: Properties for login_succeeded. Email, password, JWT, and IP address are explicitly forbidden. userId from the envelope carries the pseudonymous user UUID.

user_role.description: User role — included only if authentication progressed enough to resolve the role.

loginFailedProperties.description: Properties for login_failed. Raw email, raw password, IP address, and any form of credential are explicitly forbidden.

userRegisteredProperties.description: Properties for user_registered. Email, name, phone, address, and password are explicitly forbidden. userId from envelope carries the newly created user's UUID.

supplierStatusChangedProperties.description: Properties for supplier_status_changed. contact_email, notes, and any free-text fields are explicitly forbidden.

field.description: Field name that failed validation (field name only, not the submitted value).

status_code.description: HTTP status code for the validation error (400 for /incidents, 422 for other endpoints).

apiValidationErrorProperties.description: Properties for api_validation_error. Raw request body, submitted field values, raw exception text, stack trace, and filesystem paths are explicitly forbidden.

status_code.description: HTTP status code for the server error.

apiServerErrorProperties.description: Properties for api_server_error. Raw exception message, stack trace, filesystem paths, request body, variable values, secrets, and environment variable values are explicitly forbidden.

sku_count.description: Number of SKUs queried (for list endpoint).

inventoryQueryDurationProperties.description: Properties for inventory_query_duration. Query text, database credentials, connection strings, and schema details are explicitly forbidden.

oneOf.title: incident_created
oneOf.description: Emitted when a new incident is successfully created via POST /api/incidents. Context-Derived Mandatory event. Category: Incidents. Delivery: STREAM. Producer: backend. Entity: Incident. Volume: MEDIUM. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: incident_status_transition
oneOf.description: Emitted when an incident status is successfully changed via PATCH /api/incidents/{id}/status. Context-Derived Mandatory event. Category: Incidents. Delivery: STREAM. Producer: backend. Entity: Incident. Volume: LOW. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId primary, requestId secondary.

oneOf.title: sku_created
oneOf.description: Emitted when a new SKU/product is created via POST /inventory/products. Opportunity event. Category: Inventory / Operations. Delivery: BATCH. Producer: backend. Entity: SKU. Volume: VERY LOW. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: inbound_registered
oneOf.description: Emitted when goods receipt is successfully registered via POST /inventory/orders/inbound. Opportunity event. Category: Inventory / Operations. Delivery: BATCH. Producer: backend. Entity: StockEntry. Volume: LOW. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: outbound_registered
oneOf.description: Emitted when a dispatch or loss is successfully registered via POST /inventory/orders/outbound. Opportunity event. Category: Inventory / Operations. Delivery: BATCH. Producer: backend. Entity: StockExit. Volume: LOW. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: outbound_insufficient_stock
oneOf.description: Emitted when an outbound operation is rejected due to insufficient stock (HTTP 400). Opportunity event. Category: Inventory / Operations. Delivery: STREAM. Producer: backend. Entity: StockExit (rejected). Volume: LOW. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: warehouse_mismatch_rejected
oneOf.description: Emitted when an inbound or outbound operation is rejected due to warehouse mismatch (HTTP 400). Opportunity event. Category: Inventory / Operations. Delivery: BATCH. Producer: backend. Entity: StockEntry / StockExit (rejected). Volume: VERY LOW. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: sku_duplicate_rejected
oneOf.description: Emitted when an attempt to create a SKU that already exists is rejected (HTTP 409). Opportunity event. Category: Inventory / Operations. Delivery: BATCH. Producer: backend. Entity: SKU (rejected). Volume: VERY LOW. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: login_succeeded
oneOf.description: Emitted when a user successfully logs in via POST /auth/login (HTTP 200). Opportunity event. Category: Authentication / Session. Delivery: BATCH. Producer: backend. Entity: User session. Volume: LOW-MEDIUM. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: login_failed
oneOf.description: Emitted when a login attempt fails via POST /auth/login (HTTP 401). Opportunity event. Category: Authentication / Session. Delivery: STREAM. Producer: backend. Entity: User session (failed). Volume: LOW (can spike during attacks). Sampling: NONE (capture all for security); throttle above 20 events/min per ephemeral IP-hash key. Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: user_registered
oneOf.description: Emitted when a new user account is created via POST /users (HTTP 201). Opportunity event. Category: Authentication / Session. Delivery: BATCH. Producer: backend. Entity: User. Volume: LOW. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: supplier_status_changed
oneOf.description: Emitted when a supplier status is changed via PATCH /suppliers/{id}/status (HTTP 200). Opportunity event. Category: Suppliers. Delivery: BATCH. Producer: backend. Entity: Supplier. Volume: VERY LOW. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: api_validation_error
oneOf.description: Emitted when a FastAPI RequestValidationError is raised on any endpoint (HTTP 422 default, or HTTP 400 for /incidents). Opportunity event. Category: Errors / Validation. Delivery: BATCH. Producer: backend. Entity: API request. Volume: LOW-MEDIUM. Sampling: 1:10 for non-incident endpoints; 100% for /incidents endpoints. Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: api_server_error
oneOf.description: Emitted when an unhandled exception reaches the unhandled_exception_handler (HTTP 500). Opportunity event. Category: Errors / Validation. Delivery: STREAM. Producer: backend. Entity: API request. Volume: VERY LOW. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId.

oneOf.title: inventory_query_duration
oneOf.description: Emitted on completion of _stock_for_sku() calls inside list_products() and get_product(). Opportunity event. Category: Performance. Delivery: STREAM. Producer: backend. Entity: Performance measurement. Volume: LOW. Sampling: NONE (capture all). Deduplication: eventId.
